text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm discussing today's training with
Narita Brian,
when...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Got it. Guess I'm running laps today,
then.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...What are you doing? Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to run, so I'm going ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...There's a nice breeze. It's got my
blood
pumping—I feel like I could run to
the end of the
earth.
I see. Wind... Blood... Run...
Uh, uh-oh!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tch. No way I can ignore that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Come out, you lil' rat. I know you're in
the bushes.
A-all right!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: What's up, Brian?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...What do you think you're doing,
following me
around from the crack of
dawn?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Well... Hm... Hmph... Guess I'm busted.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? That's quite the attitude.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Oh? Look who's talking.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No way! It's... an homage. I totally
respect Brian!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...I don't get what you're saying.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wanna be just like you! I wanna be
powerful and
cool!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I started followin' you this
morning.
I've been studyin' the way you
move and how you
talk!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You want to be... like me?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
You think you can compare to me with a
shallow
impersonation? ...Don't kid
yourself.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
If you wanna run on the same track as
me, come
prepared to tear it to shreds.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: O-of course!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
...I look up to you and your unshakable,

straightforward confidence.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run just as fast as—no, I'm
gonna
surpass you! You'll see!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna run just as fast as—no, I'm
gonna
surpass you! You'll see!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Really?! So does that mean I'm gettin'
closer to
being the real deal?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Then I don't have time to stand around
and chat! I
gotta train too!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... Not just match me, but you
think you can
surpass me?! That's quite a
loud bark you got.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: But it's me who'll be biting.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It could be because she was provoked,
but she's
even more vigorous than usual
in training
afterward.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Huh?! C-can I really?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I had no intention of allowing this... but I
guess
you're free to follow me of your
own accord.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Augh! I lost! One more, please!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Hmph... It doesn't matter how many
times we go,
I'll still defeat you.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
They continue until Vodka has had
enough, and it
turns out to be a very
productive training session.
